character.name: Idle

Tall spiky BLACK hair with very short shaved sides, thick eyebrows, black aviator sunglasses, square jaw with short dark beard stubble. Black suit and white shirt with black tie. SILVER-GRAY METAL PLATES bolted OVER BOTH shoulders, two long angular upper-chest plates beside lapels, and paired plates on BOTH upper arms. Cloth suit remains visible at torso center, abdomen and forearms. No helmet, no full torso cuirass, no ammunition belts. Preserve the supplied sprite identity, anatomy, iris color and clothing. Empty hands, relaxed upright stance, no weapons or shadow.
